profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Rehrig Pacific Company | C#/.NET Development
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise systems, manufacturing platforms, cloud-native services, and production-critical integrations. Skilled in C#/.NET development, enterprise architecture, CI/CD automation, hardware-integrated software, and cross-system debugging across CRM, ERP, and middleware platforms. Trusted to lead production incident resolution, elevate engineering quality, and deliver software that directly supports operational manufacturing and supply chain workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I contributed significantly to Rehrig Pacific Company by enhancing manufacturing processes with innovative software solutions.  

• Independently redesigned Jenkins pipelines, resulting in improved build quality and accountability.  
• Developed workflows that provided better visibility into supply chain operations, including product commissioning and shipping.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to support live deployments and troubleshoot critical workflows.
• Feature development and maintenance of 5+ .NET enterprise applications
• Contribute to design and architecture of new applications and integrations based on business requirements
